title: Shipwreck

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Shipwrecks are Points of interest found around the shores of the Black Forest, Swamp and Plains.
They come in 4 variants. They have a 74.9% chance for a Shipwreck Chest that contains valuables.
The different parts of shipwrecks can be destroyed for Finewood. Large parts yield between 10 and 15 Finewood, and small parts yield between 3 and 6 Finewood.
